function.name: create_invoice
function.description: Creates a new invoice record with specified details for a customer. This tool allows for the generation of a new invoice, assigning it to a customer, and defining its initial status and due date.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer for whom the invoice is being created.

amount.description: The total monetary amount of the invoice.

currency.description: The currency of the invoice amount (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR').

due_date.description: The date by which the invoice is expected to be paid, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

status.description: The initial status of the invoice (e.g., 'draft', 'pending', 'sent').

function.name: get_invoice_details
function.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a specific invoice using its unique identifier. This includes information about the customer, amount, status, and line items.

invoice_id.description: The unique identifier of the invoice to retrieve details for.

function.name: update_invoice_status
function.description: Updates the status of an existing invoice. This is useful for tracking the lifecycle of an invoice from creation to payment.

invoice_id.description: The unique identifier of the invoice to update.

new_status.description: The new status to set for the invoice (e.g., 'paid', 'overdue', 'cancelled').

paid_date.description: The date the invoice was paid, required if new_status is 'paid', in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.name: list_invoices_by_customer
function.description: Retrieves a list of invoices associated with a specific customer, with optional filtering by status or date range. This helps in viewing a customer's billing history.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer whose invoices are to be listed.

status_filter.description: Optional: Filter invoices by their current status (e.g., 'pending', 'paid', 'overdue').

start_date.description: Optional: Filter invoices issued on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: Optional: Filter invoices issued on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

function.name: send_invoice_reminder
function.description: Sends a reminder notification for an overdue invoice to the associated customer. This tool helps in proactive collection efforts.

invoice_id.description: The unique identifier of the invoice for which to send a reminder.

reminder_message.description: Optional: Custom message to include in the reminder.

include_payment_link.description: Optional: Whether to include a direct payment link in the reminder.

function.name: delete_invoice
function.description: Deletes an invoice record permanently using its unique identifier. This action is typically used for draft invoices or those created in error.

invoice_id.description: The unique identifier of the invoice to be deleted.

force_delete.description: Set to true to bypass soft delete and permanently remove the invoice.

function.name: compare_product_prices
function.description: Compares prices for a given product across multiple online retailers. It returns a list of offers sorted by price.

product_name.description: The name of the product to compare prices for.

min_rating.description: Minimum average customer rating for the product (0.0 to 5.0).

max_results.description: Maximum number of price offers to return.

function.name: get_retailer_inventory_status
function.description: Checks the current inventory status for a specific product at a given retailer.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the product.

retailer_id.description: The unique identifier of the retailer.

check_availability.description: If true, also checks if the product is available for immediate shipping.

function.name: add_price_alert
function.description: Creates a price alert for a product. Users will be notified if the price drops below a specified threshold.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the product for which to set an alert.

target_price.description: The target price threshold. An alert will be triggered if the price falls below this.

currency.description: The currency of the target price (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR').

user_email.description: The email address to send the alert notification to.

function.name: get_product_price_history
function.description: Retrieves the historical price data for a given product over a specified period.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the product.

start_date.description: The start date for the price history in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The end date for the price history in YYYY-MM-DD format.

retailer_id.description: Optional: Filter history for a specific retailer.

function.name: update_price_alert
function.description: Modifies an existing price alert's target price or notification email.

alert_id.description: The unique identifier of the price alert to update.

new_target_price.description: The new target price threshold for the alert.

new_user_email.description: The new email address for notifications.

is_active.description: Set to false to deactivate the alert.

function.name: search_similar_products
function.description: Finds products similar to a given product, potentially from different brands or with slightly different specifications, to help users broaden their comparison.

product_id.description: The unique identifier of the reference product.

similarity_threshold.description: A numerical value (0.0 to 1.0) indicating how strict the similarity matching should be. Higher is stricter.

max_results.description: Maximum number of similar products to return.

include_different_brands.description: Set to true to include similar products from different brands.
